resources.string: The same installer is both the Sender and the Receiver. After installing it on the TV, open it and it goes straight to “Ready to receive”.

This app was installed as split packages (for example, from an app store), so it can\'t be shared to the TV directly. Download the universal installer from the project\'s release page and install it with a USB drive or the TV\'s browser.

The installer on this device only contains %1$s. Many TV boxes run 32-bit systems and may not be able to install it. Use the universal installer from the release page instead, or install the matching version from a USB drive.
Method 1: Share the installer from your phone (recommended)
The phone and the TV must be on the same router. Sharing is visible only on the local network and stops automatically when you leave this page or after 10 minutes.
Couldn\'t start sharing. Make sure your phone is connected to Wi‑Fi and try again, or install from a USB drive
In the TV browser\'s address bar, enter:
QR code for the installer download address (for other phones or tablets)
Copy the installer to a USB drive, plug it into the TV, and open it with the TV\'s “File manager” to install. Some TVs require allowing “Install unknown apps” in system settings first.

Many TVs have built-in DLNA receiving: without installing this app, you can Push videos, photos and music from your phone in the “TV’s built-in casting” group of the device list (Screen mirroring isn\'t available).
A free, open-source (GPL‑3.0) LAN screen-casting Receiver that never goes online. Open it after installing and it goes straight to “Ready to receive”.
After downloading, open it from the TV\'s “File manager” or “Downloads” to install. If installation is blocked, allow this browser / file manager to “Install unknown apps” in system settings.
